capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 83 kWh gross x 0.95 (the AU/NZ Model Y L is 88.2 gross / about 84 usable on Wikipedia, ratio 0.95). Ratio from the sibling L pack, not the US car.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: Model Y L uses NCM cells (China and AU/NZ listings); US pack chemistry not stated. Unproven for the US car: Wikipedia cites NCM for China/AU-NZ builds only.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Same Model Y platform, 400 V; no L-specific voltage page found.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: Not a Tesla App: "83 kWh pack" for the US Model Y L, gross or usable unstated; a bare pack figure is treated as gross (the China pack of 88 kWh is Wikipedia's 88.2 gross).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Not a Tesla App: 250 kW peak Supercharging for the US Model Y L.
